reviews.content: I attempted to use the chatbot to revoke a user’s access urgently but encountered repeated unhelpful responses that did not address my explicit request or frustration. The bot provided overly detailed text instructions without any visual aids despite my request, and failed to offer escalation even after I expressed urgency and dissatisfaction. Please escalate this issue and implement a direct, clear, and responsive process to revoke user access immediately. Attached is the conversation transcript for reference.
